bare.title: Bare earth
bare.text: Your first hizb will bring your garden to life.

thirsty.title: Your garden is thirsty
thirsty.text: One page is enough to bring the water back.

wilting.title: Your garden is wilting
wilting.text: A page today, and it regains its strength.

dying.title: Your garden is withering
dying.text: One page already brings some elements back.

dead.title: Nothing is lost
dead.text: The hizb you have read stay yours. One page brings the water back.

recovering.title: The water is back
recovering.text: Your garden is regaining its strength. Keep going tomorrow.

complete.title: Khatma complete
complete.text: Your garden is complete. Read a page to start the next one: a new garden awaits you.

finish.labelNext: Estimated End of the Next Khatma

unavailable.title: Garden Unavailable
unavailable.description: The garden’s state can’t be worked out. Close the app, then open it again.
